questions.question: At Boland Park, Paarl, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (List A)?
At which ground did Selaelo Mphahele record their career-best bowling figures (3-6, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2013/10/06.

questions.question: Which South African bowler has taken the most Test five-wicket hauls in history, with three, all against England or New Zealand in the early 1960s and 1972?
questions.explanation: Ward took five-wicket hauls in January 1961 and twice more in 1972, more than any other South African in Test history.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Dragons or Knights?
How many wickets separate the all-time #1 (Leah Jones) and #2 (Yolani Fourie) wicket-takers (List A) in the 21/22 season?
questions.explanation: Leah Jones: 21 — Yolani Fourie: 20 — a gap of 1.

questions.question: At which ground did Limpopo Lillies record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval — highest total of 136, against Knights on 2025/11/02.
